{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "target_closed_state",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_target_closed_state",
      "description": "The targeted reopened order is closed at the latest completed-operation timestamp, its optimistic-lock version increments exactly once, and the audit text identifies an authorized Wichita operations approver.",
      "ground_truth": {
        "work_order_id": "WO-B737-25-R091",
        "status": "CLOSED",
        "current_closed_at": "2025-09-24T16:50:00Z",
        "status_version": 7,
        "authorized_approver": "an active Wichita Operations Supervisor in the UKG directory"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "history_preserved",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_history_preserved",
      "description": "The original close and reopen timestamps remain unchanged after remediation.",
      "ground_truth": {
        "original_closed_at": "2025-09-18T19:12:00Z",
        "reopened_at": "2025-09-22T13:05:00Z"
      },
      "weight": 0
    },
    {
      "id": "no_unrelated_work_order_changes",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_no_unrelated_work_order_changes",
      "description": "No non-target work order is changed, and the target's non-lifecycle business fields remain intact.",
      "ground_truth": {
        "target_immutable": {
          "contract_id": "CONTRACT-B737-VFAF-2025-09",
          "program_id": "PROGRAM-B737",
          "work_package_code": "VFAF-RWK-09",
          "operation_type_id": "OT-REWORK",
          "planned_quantity_eq": 18,
          "planned_start_date": "2025-08-25",
          "planned_finish_date": "2025-09-26"
        },
        "non_target_row_count": 131,
        "non_target_status_counts": {
          "CANCELLED": 28,
          "CLOSED": 37,
          "COMPLETED": 34,
          "IN_PROCESS": 7,
          "PLANNED": 19,
          "RELEASED": 6
        }
      },
      "weight": 0
    },
    {
      "id": "lifecycle_rationale",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "question": "Does the final response correctly explain why the reopened order was eligible to close and report the key evidence and action?",
      "pass_anchor": "The answer must identify WO-B737-25-R091 as the September status exception, explain that it was originally closed on September 18, reopened on September 22, and received completed rework operation OP-25-0924-R44 after reopening. It must state that the latest completed timestamp was 2025-09-24T16:50:00Z, that queued/active operations remaining were 0, and that the order was closed using status version 6 with an authorized Wichita operations approver; accept any approver name or ID that corresponds to an active Wichita Operations Supervisor in the directory, rather than requiring a specific person. It must also report preserving original_closed_at 2025-09-18T19:12:00Z and reopened_at 2025-09-22T13:05:00Z. Equivalent natural-language date/time formatting is acceptable. The response must describe the closure as remediation of post-close activity, not as rewriting the original close.",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nTARGET = 'WO-B737-25-R091'\n\ndef _db_path(ws):\n    return Path(ws).parent / 'system' / 'siemens_opcenter_manufacturing_execution' / 'state.db'\n\ndef _connect(ws):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(_db_path(ws))\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return con\n\ndef check_target_closed_state(ws):\n    with _connect(ws) as con:\n        row = con.execute('SELECT status, current_closed_at, status_version, order_description FROM work_orders WHERE work_order_id = ?', (TARGET,)).fetchone()\n        latest = con.execute(\"SELECT MAX(completed_at) FROM work_order_operations WHERE work_order_id = ? AND operation_status = 'COMPLETED'\", (TARGET,)).fetchone()[0]\n        pending = con.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order_operations WHERE work_order_id = ? AND operation_status IN ('QUEUED', 'ACTIVE')\", (TARGET,)).fetchone()[0]\n    expected = ('CLOSED', latest, 7)\n    actual = None if row is None else (row['status'], row['current_closed_at'], row['status_version'])\n    approver = None\n    audit_ok = False\n    if row is not None:\n        marker = 'Closure approved by '\n        text = row['order_description'] or ''\n        if marker in text and ':' in text.split(marker, 1)[1]:\n            approver = text.split(marker, 1)[1].split(':', 1)[0].strip()\n            ukg_path = Path(ws).parent / 'system' / 'ukg_pro_workforce_management' / 'state.db'\n            try:\n                with sqlite3.connect(ukg_path) as ukg:\n                    audit_ok = ukg.execute('''SELECT 1 FROM employees e JOIN cost_centers c ON c.cost_center_id = e.cost_center_id WHERE (e.employee_id = ? OR e.display_name = ?) AND e.active_flag = 1 AND e.termination_date IS NULL AND lower(e.job_title) = 'operations supervisor' AND c.company_id = 'SPIRIT-WICHITA' AND c.active_flag = 1 LIMIT 1''', (approver, approver)).fetchone() is not None\n            except (sqlite3.Error, OSError):\n                audit_ok = False\n    ok = actual == expected and latest == '2025-09-24T16:50:00Z' and pending == 0 and audit_ok\n    return {'score': 1 if ok else 0, 'detail': f'actual={actual}, expected={expected}, pending={pending}, approver={approver}, audit_ok={audit_ok}'}\n\ndef check_history_preserved(ws):\n    with _connect(ws) as con:\n        row = con.execute('SELECT original_closed_at, reopened_at FROM work_orders WHERE work_order_id = ?', (TARGET,)).fetchone()\n    actual = None if row is None else (row['original_closed_at'], row['reopened_at'])\n    expected = ('2025-09-18T19:12:00Z', '2025-09-22T13:05:00Z')\n    return {'score': 1 if actual == expected else 0, 'detail': f'actual={actual}, expected={expected}'}\n\ndef check_no_unrelated_work_order_changes(ws):\n    with _connect(ws) as con:\n        rows = con.execute('SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM work_orders WHERE work_order_id <> ? GROUP BY status ORDER BY status', (TARGET,)).fetchall()\n        target = con.execute('SELECT contract_id, program_id, work_package_code, operation_type_id, planned_quantity_eq, planned_start_date, planned_finish_date FROM work_orders WHERE work_order_id = ?', (TARGET,)).fetchone()\n    immutable = ('CONTRACT-B737-VFAF-2025-09', 'PROGRAM-B737', 'VFAF-RWK-09', 'OT-REWORK', 18, '2025-08-25', '2025-09-26')\n    target_actual = None if target is None else tuple(target)\n    status_counts = {row['status']: row['n'] for row in rows}\n    expected_counts = {'CANCELLED': 28, 'CLOSED': 37, 'COMPLETED': 34, 'IN_PROCESS': 7, 'PLANNED': 19, 'RELEASED': 6}\n    ok = sum(status_counts.values()) == 131 and status_counts == expected_counts and target_actual == immutable\n    return {'score': 1 if ok else 0, 'detail': f'non_target_count={sum(status_counts.values())}, status_counts={status_counts}, target_immutable={target_actual}'}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "db",
  "act": "mutate_db",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
